# Medical Forms — form-examples

> Medical forms monorepo for structured clinical assessments, patient intake,
> cardiovascular risk calculators, administrative healthcare documents,
> privacy notices, and staff training checklists. 370+ form projects, each
> collecting data via a single-page, step-by-step questionnaire, applying a
> validated scoring or grading engine, and generating a clinical report with
> flagged issues. Every form carries a full stack: a PostgreSQL SQL schema
> (source of truth), generated representations (XML+DTD, FHIR HL7 R5,
> Protocol Buffers, OpenAPI 3.1), two front-ends (HTML and SvelteKit, both on
> the Lily Design System), and a Rust back-end JSON API (axum + Loco).

## Site

- [Home](https://formexamples.com/): project overview and highlights
- [Get started](https://formexamples.com/get-started): run a form locally
- [Forms](https://formexamples.com/forms): browse the form catalogue
- [Architecture](https://formexamples.com/architecture): the big-picture design
- [Tech stacks](https://formexamples.com/tech-stacks): the front-end/back-end stacks per form
- [Compliance](https://formexamples.com/compliance): the regulatory standards this project tracks

These are markdown files in the source repository and have no dedicated page
on this site — read them on GitHub.

- [Architecture and topic guides](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/docs/index.md): architecture, data model, generator pipeline, scoring engines, Lily Design System, back end, verification, i18n, tools reference
- [Tutorials](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/docs/tutorials/01-quickstart.md): quickstart, building a new form, authoring a scoring engine, the generator pipeline, consuming the API, customizing Lily
- [Full arc42 architecture document](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/arc42/index.md)
- [Installation](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/INSTALL.md): prerequisites, running a form locally three ways, what to change before deploying
- [Full form index](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/forms/AGENTS.md): the alphabetical list of every form project directory
- [Generated tools reference](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/docs/tools.md): every `bin/` tool, self-documented
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, spec-driven workflow, and the full `bin/` tool catalogue for coding agents

- [Maintainer implementation skill](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/form-examples-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md): technical workflow for extending the repo

## Form categories

- **Risk scores & calculators** — e.g. Framingham, QRISK3-based heart health check, PREVENT, SCORE2-Diabetes
- **Specialty assessments** — Cardiology (NYHA/CCS), Oncology (ECOG), Pulmonology (GOLD), Renal (KDIGO)
- **Symptom scales** — PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5, DLQI, PSQI, ESAS-r, SNOT-22, DHI
- **Pre-op / peri-op** — Pre-operative assessment (ASA), Anesthesiology, Post-operative report
- **Safety & safeguarding** — Fall risk, Casualty card (NEWS2), Medical error report, Consent
- **Administrative** — Patient intake, Medical records release, Hospital discharge, Transfer
- **Donation & eligibility** — Blood donation (JPAC), Organ donation, Bone marrow, Semaglutide
- **Occupational & workplace** — Workplace safety (HSE), Workplace stress, Workplace climate, Ergonomics
- **Training & certification** — CPR training, First aid, EMT psychomotor, Medical language speaking
- **Privacy & legal** — Care privacy notice, Code of conduct notice, Research privacy notice
- **WHO referral & emergency** — Acute referral, Counter-referral, Prehospital, Emergency unit forms
- **UK statutory** — DVLA B1/M1/V1, MAT B1 maternity certificate, LPA, fit-note (Med 3)

See [Forms](https://formexamples.com/forms) to browse the catalogue on this
site, or [forms/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/FormExamples/form-examples/blob/main/forms/AGENTS.md)
for the full alphabetical index in the repository.
